tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on B1 Cell Structure

questions.question: Name three structures found in both animal and plant cells.
questions.correctAnswer: Nucleus, cell membrane, cytoplasm, mitochondria, ribosomes (any three)
questions.explanation: Answer: Nucleus, cell membrane, cytoplasm, mitochondria, ribosomes (any three)

questions.question: Name three structures found in plant cells but NOT in animal cells.
questions.correctAnswer: Cell wall (cellulose), chloroplasts, permanent vacuole (cell sap)
questions.explanation: Answer: Cell wall (cellulose), chloroplasts, permanent vacuole (cell sap)

questions.question: A cell is measured as 0.02 mm in real life. It appears as 40 mm in a micrograph. Calculate the magnification.
